title: "The Teachers' Lounge": A Former Teacher's Perspective

commenti.body: I'm around lots of teachers and they all adored Entre les Murs (The Class, 2008), depicting the life of a French teacher in a banlieue. Highly recommend it, great movie about the milieu, pretty realistic while keeping a beautiful if not idealistic perspective. It's based on a novel from François Bégaudeau who plays the role of the teacher in the movie, and he draws inspiration from his real life teaching. It got the Palme d'Or in Cannes.
\+1 was literally about to recommend this film as well! also would recommend wiseman's documentary at berkeley, he does a magnificent job of capturing the academic culture of a place

wow OP i have to applaud the piece and really encourage those who appreciate film writing to check this small piece out - i am a former educator and i think sometimes reading about teaching or watching movies about just opens old wounds and even triggers grief. i don’t know what I’m grieving exactly but it was such an insane experience looking back...instant subscribe, thanks stranger for sharing
OMG I just shared this with the writer and they couldn't be more thrilled about your enjoyment of it. Thank you! 😭
Thank you so much for the recommendation - I will 100% check it out! Your teacher friends sound like they have similar taste - maybe we should do a teacher movie club 😂
